name: Super Retail Group Limited
summary: Super Retail Group Limited engages in the retail of automotive, sports, and outdoor leisure products in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates through the Supercheap Auto, rebel, BCF, and Macpac segments. It offers automotive and service parts, accessories, and tools for travel, touring, outdoors, garage, shed, and outdoors. The company also provides sporting equipment and apparel; products for outdoor categories, including fishing, boating, 4WD, camping, caravanning, BBQ, power, and refrigeration; camping and outdoor equipment; fitment and support services, including wiper blade, bulb, and battery installation; battery and oil recycling; and paint mixing and vehicle diagnostics.
